title: 0.2.20 release metadata guard
summary: This update tightens the release readiness check so package metadata cannot silently point at a stale revision.
highlights: Pre-release checks now verify that source REVISION belongs to the current branch history.
Updated release metadata for the next manual in-platform update test.
No local self-upgrade is performed by the build workflow; users can update manually from the platform.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
